evidence.quote: Head Office letter No. Coord/5(15)/09/International Worker dt. 25/11/10

relationships.scope: The February 2011 circular forwarding the Gazette notifications refers to the Head Office letter of 25 November 2010 on the same amendments; it adds to it and does not replace it.

evidence.quote: circulated vide Head Office letter No. Coord/5(15)/2009/IW/07733

relationships.scope: The 30 August 2011 compliance instructions recall the 11 September 2010 notification as circulated by the Head Office letter of 25/26 November 2010; they issue further instructions for ready reference.

The 25 May 2012 circular records that detailed instructions were issued by the 8 September 2009 letter and the compliance letter of 30 August 2011, and issues clarifications after representations; it does not withdraw the 2011 circular.

evidence.quote: clarified vide Head Office letter No. lWU/7(17)2009 dated 25.05.2012

relationships.scope: Candidate link: the 31 August 2012 circular relies on a Head Office letter of 25 May 2012 stating that persons posted abroad with a Certificate of Coverage are not International Workers; the issuer's 25 May 2012 circular on compliance is the likely match but its file number is not legible.

evidence.quote: In order to remove such hardships by aligning the procedure for payment to the overseas bank accounts of International Workers and their beneficiaries with extant rule position/ legislations

relationships.scope: The 18 March 2026 circular lays down a simplified and consolidated procedure for payment to overseas bank accounts of International Workers of Social Security Agreement countries, removing the Form 15CB and 15CA hardships of the procedure laid down by the 20 October 2014 circular (number 19453). It does not state that the 2014 circular is withdrawn; read the 2026 procedure for the current position.

limitations: This collection covers circulars on international workers (EPF Scheme para 83 and EPS special provisions), Certificates of Coverage, individual Social Security Agreements and overseas-bank payment (2008-2026). Training workshops, RTI references and unit staffing circulars are not included.

The 2012 and 2017 circulars on the definition of 'International Worker' and 'excluded employee' refer to earlier circulars that are not in the set (for example the circular of 8 June 2017, which the 23 June 2017 circular says 'stands withdrawn', and the circular of 14 July 2017 cited in October 2021). No link is asserted to them.

The January 2009 and later compliance circulars state different dates for the start of enrolment (1 November 2008 and 1 October 2008 appear in different circulars); only the 7 January 2009 statement is recorded as an effective date.

Each Social Security Agreement circular records the date from which the agreement is in force, as stated in it; the Gazette notification and agreement text are not reproduced. Only the agreements that have an English-titled circular in the issuer's table are included, so the set does not list every agreement India has signed.

The 2026 circular on payment to overseas bank accounts changes the procedure of the 20 October 2014 circular without stating that it is withdrawn, so the link is recorded as a partial modification; instructions of 23 March 2017 on payment on the date of leaving service are also in the set and are not stated to be replaced.
Dates of a few early circulars are blank or partly legible in the scan; their issue dates follow the issuer listing.
Dates follow the letter, not the issuer listing; entries whose letter date differs carry a date_note.

PDFs were read from the issuer mirror on 4 November 2026 because the public site returned 404 for these paths; recorded SHA-256 values apply to those files. Scanned pages are OCR. Issue dates were checked against the document headers.
